title: Explosive Barrel Hook to Ogre Siege Climax

clips.why: Cannonball detonates the red explosive barrel in a massive shockwave
Shows manual drag-to-aim cannon firing at left and right goblin waves
Recruited Fire Mage deploys on the tower and lobs fireballs alongside the cannon
Fast multi-lane aiming as goblins push closer to the castle wall
Upgraded central cannon fires noticeably faster at advancing enemies
Heavy siege with large ogres and goblins attacking both walls
